notes.title: The blood collection outpost is now complete.
notes.content: I’m also reducing the fog and leaning into deeper darkness — a return to the original concept.

notes.title: Time Rewind Mechanic ⏪🚗
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cRPBsRPL2Sc;full][/previewyoutube]
One of the latest additions to the game is the Time Rewind mechanic! Even small adjustments in angle or speed can drastically change the outcome of jumps and turns. Now, instead of restarting a run, you can rewind time and explore different trajectories to find the perfect path.

But it’s not unlimited—rewind is restricted by energy, so you’ll need to use it wisely! Mastering this mechanic will open up new possibilities for skillful driving and puzzle-solving.

🔧 Also, a quick update—fixed a camera bug! 🎥✅ Development is moving forward, and new features are coming soon!

💙 Add to your wishlist and be among the first to try it out! 🚀

notes.title: Post-Speed: I'm continuing to actively develop the game!
Hello, this is the first entry! New Buttons in Game and Major UI Optimization.
notes.content:
New button models have been introduced in-game, slightly protruding from the floor to provide more tactile feedback. Additionally, a major UI optimization was conducted, reworking most UI functions and refactoring all components that interact with the interface. This overhaul enhances performance and ensures a smoother user experience.
